title: Swallowed gum stays 7 years? Here's the truth 🫧
caption:
Your mum lied. Kind of 😅🫧
Share with someone who believed this 👇
first_comment: Did you believe the 7 year thing? 👇
sources: Milov D. E. et al. (1998) 'Chewing gum bezoars of the gastrointestinal tract', Pediatrics 102(2): e22 (rare blockages after swallowing large amounts often)
Mayo Clinic and Cleveland Clinic: swallowed gum is not digested but normally passes through the digestive tract within days; it does not stay for seven years
